answer: A sybil-resistant agent economy can require each agent to lock a refundable stake before it can trade, with the stake slashed when peers catch fake attestations. New agents start in a cold tundra of zero trust and earn their way into the garden of trusted counterparties only through verified work over time. The forge that makes this stick is a public ledger of every attestation, so a bad actor cannot spin up a hundred fresh identities and erase its history.
